summary: A delivery/shop app with Admin Panel and customer-facing web interface. Admin-to-Web sync is implemented. Critical repair needed: restoring UPI Payment Settings, QR code generation, and persistent settings storage.
architectural_notes: UPI ID (9708075648-1@okbizaxis) must be linked to dynamic QR code generation on every bill — do not remove this logic
Admin settings (Logo, UPI, Store Name) must persist in database and never be reset on app updates
known_issues: Admin Settings (UPI Payment Settings card) were deleted and need to be restored

existing_features.title: Restore the 'UPI Payment Settings' card in the Admin Settings page (AdminSettingsPage.tsx). It must contain a labeled text input field for the UPI ID and a 'Save UPI' button. On click, the button must call the backend mutation to persist the UPI ID to the canister's stable state. The input must be pre-populated with the currently saved UPI ID on page load.

In the BillTemplate component, dynamically fetch the saved UPI ID from the backend (via `getUpiId`) and use it to generate the UPI QR code displayed on every bill. The QR code URL must be constructed using the live UPI ID value, not a hardcoded string. The default fallback must be '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' if the backend returns empty.

new_feature_requests.summary: Restore UPI Payment Settings card in Admin Panel with input field and Save UPI button that saves to database
Link UPI ID 9708075648-1@okbizaxis to generate dynamic QR code on every bill
Ensure persistent settings (Logo, UPI, Store Name) are locked in database and not reset during app updates

In the backend (main.mo), ensure the UPI ID is stored in a stable variable so it survives canister upgrades and is never reset. The `getUpiId` query and `setUpiId` update methods must be present and correctly reference this stable variable. Pre-seed the value with '9708075648-1@okbizaxis' as the default if no value has been saved yet.

Ensure that all persistent admin settings — Store Logo, UPI ID, and Store Name/Slogan — are stored in stable variables in the Motoko backend (main.mo) so they are never reset during canister upgrades. Verify existing stable vars for logo and store name/slogan are present and correctly preserved across upgrades.
